title: 第1045章 摧枯拉朽四第1044章 摧枯拉朽三
content_zh:
楚东流本以为他至少能跟余烬抗衡许久，可谁料余烬手腕一震，那柄须弥重剑上随即迸发出一种不讲道理的恐怖力量！
那股力量仿佛从余烬体内像火山一般迅速爆发，仅仅只是将剑身平平向前一推，却如山洪决堤之势，沿着剑面轰然撞上了金钵！
楚东流只觉一股沛然莫御的巨力从钵身传来，他的虎口瞬间崩裂，鲜血涌出，整条右臂的骨骼发出不堪重负的呻吟。
金钵在下一刻脱手飞出，在半空中打着旋划过一道弧线，深深嵌进了万丈外的半座崖壁之中，钵身周围的岩石炸裂出一个丈许宽的大坑。
与此同时，钵口倒扣的青色光圈彻底崩碎。太古剑魂发出一声解脱般的清越长鸣，那团朦胧的剑影从碎裂的光圈中挣脱而出，如鱼归大海，化作一道青白色的流光急坠而下，迅速没入了干涸的剑意池底。
池底瞬间涌出汩汩的青色剑光，太古剑魂在控制着剑意池。
剑意池活过来了，之前被金钵收取的古剑意倒流而回，整座原始剑墟的气息都在迅速回暖。
楚东流顾不上去看金钵的下落，也顾不上知道太古剑魂在干什么，他的心跳在这个刹那漏跳一拍，因为余烬的须弥重剑已经再次举起，没有任何花哨，没有任何招式，只是简简单单的一记猛砸，朝着他的肩头落去
楚东流抬臂格挡，金色仙元罡气在臂膀上凝成一面厚重的光盾。但那光盾在须弥剑面前脆得像一层薄冰，黑沉沉的剑面落下的瞬间，罡气碎裂，楚东流的左肩发出一声闷响，整个人被砸得向后踉跄，脚下不断踩出一个个深深的脚印。
更让楚东流气急败坏的是，还没等他消化第一剑，第二剑已经到了。这一次是横砸，剑面带着沉闷的破风之声拍在他的腰侧，将他整个人像根钉子一样横向拍了出去。
他在半空中喷出一口血雾，身体翻滚着撞碎了两根残存的剑柱，最后砸入地面，在碎石层中犁出一道丈许深的沟壑。
他挣扎着想要起身，第三剑从天而降。余烬高高跃起，双手握住须弥重剑的剑柄，将整柄剑当锤使，笔直地朝楚东流胸腹砸了下去。
“轰——！”
整片剑土都震了一下。以楚东流身体为中心，方圆五百丈的岩层齐齐下陷出一个恐怖深坑，蛛网般的裂纹向四周疯狂延伸。
楚东流的胸腹被砸得凹陷了一块，肋骨轻声断裂的声音连遥远处观战的剑修都听得清清楚楚。他瘫在深坑中，口中鲜血狂涌，原本整齐的月白长袍此刻碎成了布条，血肉模糊的左肩、腰侧、胸腹三处伤口触目惊心。
通天中阶的体魄，在此刻被连番轰击之下，失去了行动能力！
楚东流躺在坑底，死死盯着上方那持剑而立的身影。他的心中疯狂各种念头闪动，明明运转“天规地矩”的力量，足以镇压绝大多数神道强者才对，方圆笼罩之地一切存在都该被他的规则束缚！
可是，这个男人从头到尾身上都似乎有着一座，从他的天规地矩之中硬生生凿出了一块独立的空间！
就是那种奇怪的大道领域，杀戮空间如同磐石般不受任何法则侵蚀，稳固得不像话。天规地矩本可覆盖整片剑土，可偏偏在余烬周身三尺之内，所有的力量痕迹都被抹得干干净净。
余烬脚下，方寸之地，自成天地！

“你……”楚东流的嘴唇抖动着，鲜血顺着嘴角往下淌，他张开嘴，不知道是想求饶，还是想搬出缥缈神宗的名号最后搏一线生机……可余烬都没有给他开口的机会。
须弥重剑第三次落下。这一剑下去，天地寂静，直直地朝着楚东流的脖颈拍去。
宽厚沉重的剑刃，落下时带着一股弑神戮仙的蛮横劲风，这个刹那楚东流只来得及瞪大了眼睛，那漆黑的剑面已经撞上了他的咽喉。
“砰！”
一声沉闷至极的钝响。楚东流的整根脖子从中间凭空消失了，脑袋和肩膀之间只剩下一片模糊的血肉凹陷。他的双眼瞪得滚圆，瞳孔中的神采迅速涣散，身体在坑底抽搐了两下，便彻底不动了。那颗头颅歪向一边，脸上还凝固着张口欲言的姿态，却再也没有任何声音能从中发出！
剑土上，寂静了整整三息！！
content_en:
Chu Dongliu thought that he could at least contend with Yi Yan for a long time, but unexpectedly, Yi Yi's wrist shook, and an unreasonable and terrifying power burst out from the Sumeru heavy sword!
The power seemed to erupt from the body of the ember like a volcano. It just pushed the sword forward flatly, but like a mountain torrent, it crashed into the golden bowl along the sword surface!
Chu Dongliu felt an overwhelming force coming from the bowl. His tiger's mouth instantly burst open, blood gushed out, and the entire right arm's bones groaned under the load.
The golden bowl flew out at the next moment, spinning in mid-air and drawing an arc. It was deeply embedded in half of the cliff ten thousand feet away. The rocks around the bowl exploded into a large crater about ten feet wide.
At the same time, the cyan aperture upside down at the mouth of the bowl completely collapsed. The ancient sword soul let out a clear and long cry of relief, and the hazy sword shadow broke free from the broken halo of light. Like a fish returning to the sea, it turned into a blue-white stream of light and fell sharply down, quickly submerging into the bottom of the dry sword intention pool.
A gurgling cyan sword light instantly emerged from the bottom of the pool, and the ancient sword soul was controlling the sword intention pool.
The Sword Intent Pond came to life, and the ancient Sword Intent previously collected by the Golden Bowl flowed back, and the aura of the entire original Sword Ruins was rapidly recovering.
Chu Dongliu didn't bother to look at the whereabouts of the golden bowl, or to know what the ancient sword spirit was doing. His heart skipped a beat at this moment, because Yu Yan's Xumi epee had been raised again, without any fancy moves, just a simple slam, falling towards his shoulder.
Chu Dongliu raised his arm to block, and the golden immortal energy condensed into a thick light shield on his arm. But the light shield was as brittle as a thin layer of ice in front of the Xumi Sword. The moment the dark sword surface fell, the Gang Qi shattered. Chu Dongliu's left shoulder made a muffled sound, and his whole body was staggered backwards, leaving deep footprints under his feet.
What made Chu Dongliu even more furious was that before he could digest the first sword, the second sword had already arrived. This time it was a horizontal strike, with the sword hitting his waist with a dull sound of breaking wind, and his whole body was knocked out horizontally like a nail.
He spit out a mouthful of blood mist in mid-air, rolled his body and smashed two remaining sword pillars, and finally smashed into the ground, plowing a ravine about ten feet deep in the gravel layer.
He struggled to get up, and the third sword fell from the sky. Ember jumped up high, grasped the hilt of the Xumi Heavy Sword with both hands, used the entire sword as a hammer, and smashed it straight towards Chu Dongliu's chest and abdomen.
"Boom——!"
The entire sword soil shook. With Chu Dongliu's body as the center, the rock formations with a radius of 500 feet sank into a terrifying pit, with spiderweb-like cracks extending crazily around.
Chu Dongliu's chest and abdomen were dented by the impact, and the sound of his ribs breaking softly could be heard clearly even by the sword cultivators watching the battle from a distance. He collapsed in the pit, blood gushing from his mouth. His originally neat moon-white robe was now shredded into strips of cloth, and the three bloody wounds on his left shoulder, waist, and chest and abdomen were shocking.
The middle-level Tongtian physique lost the ability to move under the repeated bombardment at this moment!
Chu Dongliu lay at the bottom of the pit, staring at the figure standing above with a sword. All kinds of crazy thoughts were flashing in his heart. It was clear that the power of running the "rules of heaven and earth" was enough to suppress the vast majority of powerful Shinto people. All existences in the surrounding area should be bound by his rules!
However, this man seems to have an independent space carved out of his natural order from beginning to end!
It's that kind of strange avenue realm. The killing space is like a rock that is not eroded by any laws and is unbelievably stable. The laws of heaven and earth could have covered the entire sword soil, but they happened to be within three feet of the ember, and all traces of power were wiped clean.
Under the feet of the ember, a small area becomes a world of its own!
"You..." Chu Dongliu's lips trembled, blood dripping down the corners of his mouth,He opened his mouth, not sure if he wanted to beg for mercy, or if he wanted to use the name of Piao Miao Shen Sect to fight for a chance of survival... But Yi Yan didn't give him a chance to speak.
The Sumeru heavy sword fell for the third time. When the sword went down, the world was silent, and it struck straight at Chu Dongliu's neck.
The broad and heavy sword blade came down with a brutal wind that killed gods and immortals. At this moment, Chu Dongliu only had time to widen his eyes, and the dark sword surface had already hit his throat.
"Bang!"
An extremely dull sound. Chu Dongliu's entire neck disappeared out of thin air, leaving only a blur of flesh and blood between his head and shoulders. His eyes were widened, and the energy in his pupils quickly dimmed. His body twitched twice at the bottom of the pit, and then became completely motionless. The head was tilted to one side, and the face was still open to speak, but no sound could come out of it!
On the sword soil, there was silence for three whole breaths! !
